verdict.rationale: The RDAP record for namecheap.com shows contact data replaced by 'Privacy service provided by WITHHELD FOR PRIVACY LLC'. That confirms Namecheap operates a WHOIS/RDAP privacy service that redacts registrant details. Nothing in the pack shows the service is free, on by default for new registrations, or offered without an upsell. Missing for 10: evidence that privacy is free, evidence it is enabled by default, confirmation that name, address and email are redacted on customer domains, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
